- **Impact:** 2026-09-17 01:38 to 2026-09-17 02:37
- **Cause time:** 2026-09-17 01:38
- **Affected:** S-SUD-007

## Summary

Transient self-clearing environmental and antenna warnings occurred on S-SUD-007 with no underlying service degradation or KPI impact.

No impact on service or user traffic; all 20 alarms self-cleared within 10 minutes.

## Timeline

- 2026-09-17 01:38: Warning TEMP_HIGH raised on S-SUD-007. [ALM-000325, T3]
- 2026-09-17 01:45: Minor VSWR_HIGH raised on S-SUD-007. [ALM-000328, T3]
- 2026-09-17 02:30: All TEMP_HIGH alarms cleared. [ALM-000325, T3]
- 2026-09-17 02:37: All VSWR_HIGH alarms cleared. [ALM-000328, T3]

## Evidence

- S-SUD-007 generated 20 self-clearing alarms including 8 temperature warnings and 12 VSWR minor alarms. [T3, ALM-000325, ALM-000328]
- No critical or major alarms were recorded on S-SUD-007 during the observation window. [T3]
- KPIs including availability, RRC success rate, active users, and download volume showed no sustained deviation from baseline. [T4]
- No changes were performed on S-SUD-007 or its parents during the window. [T5]
- No maintenance window was scheduled on S-SUD-007 and its parents. [T6]

## Hypotheses

1. **no_impact** at S-SUD-007: confirmed. Alarms were purely transient and self-clearing, with zero impact on operational KPIs. [T3, T4]
2. **transport_failure** at LNK-SUD-02-B: rejected. No anomalies or performance drops were observed on site availability or parent links. [T1, T4]

## Ruled out

- ALM-000325: TEMP_HIGH warnings were transient and self-clearing within minutes, causing no service disruption.
- ALM-000328: VSWR_HIGH minor alarms were transient and self-clearing within minutes, accompanied by normal KPIs.

## Recommended actions

- No action required; alarms were self-clearing and service remained completely normal.
- Monitor S-SUD-007 antenna metrics if similar warning spikes recur.
